errors.name: AboveResaleCap
errors.msg: Listing price is above the event's resale cap

errors.name: DeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Deadline has not been reached yet

errors.name: InvalidState
errors.msg: Account is not in the right state for this action

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not allowed to do this

errors.name: BuyerIsSeller
errors.msg: Buyer and seller must be different

errors.name: PriceAboveMax
errors.msg: Listing price is above the standing order's max price

errors.name: InvalidResaleCap
errors.msg: Resale cap must be at least the face price

errors.name: InvalidRoyalty
errors.msg: Royalty plus fee is above the allowed maximum

errors.name: InvalidBps
errors.msg: Basis points must be between 0 and 10000

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: InvalidWindow
errors.msg: Time window must be greater than zero

errors.name: TicketNotHeld

errors.name: WrongEvent

types.name: Config
docs: Global settings. PDA ["config"].

fields.name: arbiter
docs: Only signer allowed to split a disputed escrow.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Owner of the treasury USDC token account (its ATA receives fees).

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Platform fee in basis points (300 = 3%).

fields.name: dispute_window_secs
docs: How long a dispute stays open before anyone can trigger the timeout payout.

fields.name: timeout
docs: true when settled by dispute_timeout instead of the arbiter

types.name: EscrowOrder
docs: Tier 2 escrow for an outside ticket. PDA ["escrow", seller, order_id (u64 LE)].
USDC (bond, then price) sits in this PDA's USDC ATA.

types.name: Event
docs: An artist's event. PDA ["event", organizer, event_id (u64 LE)].

fields.name: price
docs: Face price in USDC base units (6 decimals).

fields.name: resale_cap
docs: Max resale price in USDC base units.

types.name: Listing
docs: Tier 1 resale listing. PDA ["listing", ticket_mint]. The ticket sits in the
listing vault (this PDA's Token-2022 ATA for the ticket mint).

fields.name: auto
docs: true when released by release_expired (buyer never confirmed)

fields.name: amount
docs: price + bond paid to the buyer

types.name: StandingOrder
docs: Agent standing order. PDA ["standing", owner, order_id (u64 LE)].
Budget (max_price * quantity USDC) sits in this PDA's USDC ATA.

types.name: TicketRecord
docs: One per Tier 1 ticket. PDA ["ticket", ticket_mint].

fields.name: buyer
docs: Wallet that received the ticket (the standing order owner when filled by an agent).

constants.name: BPS_DENOMINATOR
docs: 10_000 basis points = 100%.

constants.name: MAX_ROYALTY_PLUS_FEE_BPS
docs: royalty_bps + fee_bps may not exceed 50%.
